original_query: Which factor has the weakest influence on a buyer's consideration list?

summaries.found_via_query: What factors influence a buyer's consideration list, and which has the weakest influence?
summaries.summary: The infographic highlights key influencers on a buyer's vehicle consideration list, with TV ads having the strongest influence at 70%, followed by reviews on vehicle sites at 80% and information on manufacturer websites at 78%. Factors with weaker influence include online video ads (36%), likes/tweets by auto manufacturers (25%), and what I hear on the radio (33%). The weakest influence is indicated as 'No Influence' at the left end of the scale, with no specific factor listed below 25%.
key_facts: TV ads have the strongest influence at 70%
Reviews on vehicle review sites have 80% influence
Information on auto manufacturer websites has 78% influence
Likes/tweets by auto manufacturers have 25% influence
What I hear on the radio has 33% influence
No influence is indicated at the left end of the scale
